messages:
Elliot Morgan: Proposal: "delta-seed" flow for air-gapped patches. Ship a tiny delta manifest + installer shim; full blobs fetched from a staging appliance after install. Aim to reduce USB size and speed ops. Thoughts on safe activation semantics?

Nina Verma: Safer if activation is conditional on blob verification. Two-phase: APPLY (unpack + register) -> VERIFY (remote fetch/verify) -> FINALIZE (atomic swap). Prevents partial runtime mutation.

Carlos Ruiz: How do we handle operator crashes between VERIFY and FINALIZE? We need idempotency keys: seed_id + manifest_hash + verify_nonce. Reapplying should pick up state and resume.

Jae Kim: Agree. Also need per-blob descriptors (id, size, sha256, sig) in manifest so operator can verify incrementally and surface missing blobs.

Elliot Morgan: Migration: old installers treated seeds as immediate apply+finalize. New operator should accept legacy seeds and map them to APPLY+VERIFY (auto-verify). Feature-flag rollout.

Nina Verma: Add a short GC window: after APPLY but before FINALIZE, blobs marked missing get a grace period before aggressive GC. Prevents race where remote fetch lags and operator prunes.

Carlos Ruiz: Observability: emit transitions seed.apply, seed.verify.start, seed.verify.done, seed.finalize with counts for missing/ok. Add an endpoint /seeds/:id/status returning per-blob state.

Jae Kim: Security: validate manifest signatures with KMS and HSM-backed keys. Include validate-token returned by VERIFY that must be presented to FINALIZE to prevent replay across manifests.

Elliot Morgan: Edge case: resumed install on different node. If seed_id matches and manifest_hash equals operator state.finalized_hash => no-op. If manifest_hash differs, reject unless admin override.

Nina Verma: Tests: power-loss at different points, interrupted verify with resume, corrupted blob on fetch. Create a tiny throttled fetcher e2e to simulate slow staging appliance.

ops-bot: Reminder: update onboarding docs and add integration test job for delta-seed resume flows.

Carlos Ruiz: I'll draft the RFC with state diagram, API endpoints (POST /seeds/:id/apply, /verify, /finalize), token format, compat plan. Review tmrw 9:30am?

Jae Kim: I'll add KMS notes and threat model.
